description: OpenTabs plugin for SQLPad — run SQL queries, browse database schemas, and manage saved queries

tools.name: get_current_user
tools.description: Get the currently authenticated user profile including ID, email, and role. Also returns the SQLPad version.

tools.name: list_users
tools.description: List all users in the SQLPad instance with their roles and email addresses.

tools.name: list_connections
tools.description: List all available database connections. Returns connection IDs, names, drivers, and configuration. Use the connection ID when running queries or fetching schemas.

tools.name: get_schema
tools.description: Get the database schema for a connection, including all schemas, tables, and columns. Useful for discovering table structures before writing queries. Filter by schema or table name to reduce output.

tools.name: run_query
tools.description: Execute a SQL query on a database connection and return the results. Only read-only SQL statements (SELECT, SHOW, DESCRIBE, EXPLAIN) are recommended. The query is submitted as a batch, polled for completion, and results are returned as objects keyed by column name. Queries have a 5-minute timeout.

tools.name: list_saved_queries
tools.description: List saved SQL queries in the workspace. Returns query names, IDs, connection IDs, and permissions. Use get_saved_query to retrieve the full SQL text.

tools.name: get_saved_query
tools.description: Get the full details of a saved query by ID, including the SQL text.

tools.name: create_saved_query
tools.description: Save a new SQL query with a name, connection, and optional tags. The query can be retrieved later by ID.

tools.name: update_saved_query
tools.description: Update an existing saved query. Only the provided fields are changed.

tools.name: delete_saved_query
tools.description: Permanently delete a saved query by ID. This action cannot be undone.

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: List all tags used across saved queries. Tags help organize and categorize queries.

tools.name: list_query_history
tools.description: List query execution history with optional filtering by connection. Returns recent queries with their execution status, duration, and row counts. Results are ordered by most recent first.
